integrity.degree_formula_basis: The inspected full text states the complex Pluecker degree and identifies it with the number of standard Young tableaux of a rectangle.
integrity.euler_basis: The Euler characteristic is reconstructed from the standard Schubert-cell decomposition, whose cells are indexed by partitions in the same rectangle.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0108133 lists the first submission on 2001-08-20.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source is a Grassmannian paper with MSC 14M15 and supplies the Pluecker-degree formula.

scientific_limitations: The main classification excludes projective-space Grassmannians, whose degree-versus-Euler comparison is trivial.
Only the total topological Euler characteristic is compared with projective degree; refined Betti and intersection data are not addressed.
An unindexed combinatorial source could contain the same rectangle maximal-chain versus element-count inequality.
title: Pluecker degree overtakes Euler characteristic beyond three line-Grassmannian exceptions
